job: Hub lane every 15 minutes (bin/component-watch.sh, BH-6972): one no-tools call per component whose open alert set changed, that decides each open alert (resolve, park, ticket or escalate) from the alert lines, the lane state and the tail of the component's logs.

composition.purpose: the four verdicts and the one-line JSON answer

composition.source: GET /api/alerts?component=<c>&state=!resolved, minus the alerts whose newest alert_decisions row settles them
composition.cap: at most COMPONENT_WATCH_ALERTS_MAX (50) alerts, each line cut to 500 characters
composition.purpose: THE SCOPED DELTA: the alerts that need a decision

composition.source: lane_paused <lane id> and the age of logs/<lane id>.log for each lane id of the component's catalog rows
the log paths of the component's catalog rows
composition.cap: the last COMPONENT_WATCH_LOG_LINES (40) lines of each, each cut to 300 characters

bounds: [lane:prompt_bytes] the prompt is cut at COMPONENT_WATCH_PROMPT_BYTES (40,000 bytes) with a [truncated] marker (VERIFIED: bin/component-watch.sh cw_prompt)
[lane:no_tools] the call runs with AGENT_CALL_NO_TOOLS=1, so the session cannot read files or the web and grow past its prompt (VERIFIED: bin/component-watch.sh call site)
[lane:dedup] no call when the alert set (ids and last_seen) is the one the last run left, or every alert is settled (VERIFIED: bin/component-watch.sh run_one)
[harness:prompt_guard] prompt_guard 720KB (VERIFIED — bounds the assembled prompt only, NOT session growth)
